items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Well, Mac Rogers and Bill Cornelison were white bands from here in San Antonio.

ctx.x: And it was H.H. Eliot from Frye then. Right. Uh, they talked about Bill Cornel, Cornel? Cornel? Cornel? Cornel? Cornel?
Bill Cornel. And Mac Rogers coming in.
